agenda_items.title: Consent Agenda
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the consent agenda A – P, as amended to remove items 3G & 3H, by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to approve the April 6, 2021 Regular Meeting Minutes
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to approve the May 11, 2021 Special Meeting Minutes
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the July 27, 2021, Study Session Summary regarding review of the 60% Draft of the East Boulder Subcommunity Plan and 55th and Arapahoe Station Area Master Plan
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to approve the purchase of a Public Trail Easement , including access rights for open space purposes, over property located at 6901 N. Foothills Highway from Raytheon Holdings, LLC for $23,500 per acre, and with the purchase price of the easement not to exceed $235,000, subject to OSMP and CAO review and acceptance of due diligence and easement documents
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to approve and authorize the city manager to execute any documents necessary to convey a non-exclusive easement over a portion of the Burke I Open Space Property , pursuant to the disposal procedures of Article XII, Section 177, of the Boulder City Charter, to the East Boulder Ditch Company for the East Boulder Ditch Fish Passage Project
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to adopt Resolution 1290 accepting the City of Boulder’s 2020 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Independent Auditor’s Reports – REMOVED from Consent – NO VOTE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The item was removed from consent with no vote.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to adopt Resolution 1291 appointing the firm of CliftonLarsonAllen to examine the financial accounts of the City of Boulder for the year ended December 31, 2021 - REMOVED from Consent – NO VOTE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The item was removed from consent with no vote.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a Motion to Adopt Resolution 1292 approving the assignment to the Housing Authority of the City of Boulder, Colorado, D/B/A Boulder Housing Partners , a body corporate and politic of the State of Colorado, of $4,500,000 of the City of Boulder, Colorado’s 2021 Private Activity Bond volume cap allocation from the state ceiling for Private Activity Bonds; and authorizing the execution and delivery of an assignment and other documents in connection therewith
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a Motion to Adopt Resolution 1293 approving the assignment of $1,400,457 of the City of Boulder, Colorado’s 2021 Private Activity Bond volume cap allocation from the state ceiling for Private Activity Bonds to the Colorado Housing and Finance Authority to be issued to Thistle; and authorizing the execution and delivery of an assignment and other documents in connection therewith
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Introduction, first reading and consideration of a motion to order published, by title only, Ordinance 8501 amending the 2014 intergovernmental agreement for hazardous materials management
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8476 submitting to the electors of the City of Boulder at the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question of extending the 0.3 percent Sales and Use Tax for Capital Improvements for 15 years, with the proceeds thereof to be used for capital improvement projects in the City of Boulder; setting forth the ballot title; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details; AND IF DESIRED Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8487 submitting to the electors of the City of Boulder at the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question to authorize the increase of debt of the city to fund capital improvements for 15 years, with the proceeds thereof to be used for capital improvement projects in the City of Boulder as set forth in the ballot; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8486 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question of amending Sections 38A, 44, and 46 of the Boulder Home Rule Charter relating to the number of signatures of registered electors required on initiative, referenda and recall petitions; setting forth the ballot title; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Third reading and motion to adopt Ordinance 8477 submitting to the electors of the City of Boulder at the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question of amending Section 7 of the Boulder City Charter relating to council compensation, by requiring that council compensation be paid in equal amounts throughout the year to be paid on the same schedule as other city employees, setting forth the ballot title; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the Study Session Summary from the July 27, 2021, Study Session regarding the Boulder Parks and Recreation Master Plan Needs Assessment Results
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to call a Special Council Meeting on August 24, 2021
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the item as part of the consent agenda by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: NO ACTION

agenda_items.title: Call-up Consideration: Landmark Alteration Certificate for installation of a 11.88 kW roof mounted solar PV system at 845 14th St., a contributing property in the University Place Historic District
agenda_items.outcome_summary: NO ACTION

agenda_items.title: Call Up Item regarding a Three- Year Extension of Development Approval for the Use Review (LUR2016 00020) for attached residential in an industrial zoning district associated amenities located at 3289 Airport Boulevard. Velo Condos is a new neighborhood of 70 homes, planned in a five-building condominium community comprised of one, two, and three-bedroom for-sale homes that include on-site permanently affordable units and five live-work condominiums. Construction has been completed on the first three of five buildings, and the applicant has presold 50 percent of the units. The building permits are issued for the final two buildings with construction expected to begin at the end of 2021
agenda_items.outcome_summary: NO ACTION

agenda_items.title: Public Hearings
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinances 8474, 8475 and 8480, each by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8474 submitting to the qualified registered electors of the City of Boulder at the municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question submitted as an initiated ordinance whether the City of Boulder shall adopt changes to the Boulder Revised Code to require that any agreement with the University of Colorado regarding terms of annexation for the land known as CU South include certain specific details, and that the annexation agreement gain voter approval in an election prior to provision of city utilities and services other than flood control facilities to or on any portion of CU South; setting forth the ballot title; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance 8474 by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8475 submitting to the qualified electors of the City of Boulder at the municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question submitted as an initiated ordinance whether the City of Boulder shall expand access to housing by allowing all housing units to be occupied by a number of people equal to the number of legal bedrooms, plus one additional person per home, provided that relevant health and safety codes are met; setting forth the ballot title; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance 8475 by a vote of 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8480 submitting to the qualified electors of the City of Boulder at the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021, the question submitted as an initiated ordinance whether the City of Boulder shall prohibit the sale and manufacture for sale of certain fur products; setting forth the ballot title; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance 8480 by a vote of 9:0.
